ps_old.ref: One grain. One day of your life.

ps_dad.instruct: A 35-year-old American man, calm baritone, distracted and busy, speaking without looking up from his work, flat and absent-minded.

ps_girl.ref: Daddy, build a castle with me?

ps_teen.instruct: A 16-year-old American teenage girl, bored, cold, dismissive, slightly annoyed, flat.

ps_woman.instruct: A 22-year-old American young woman, warm but rushed, cheerful goodbye, calling from a distance.

ps_kid.ref: Grandpa, build a castle with me?

ps_old_c.ref: You can't stop the sand. But you can choose what it builds.

lines.text: One grain. One day of your life.
lines.emo: Slow, intimate, mysterious, a soft pause between the two sentences.

lines.text: The day she was born, I had eighteen thousand left. Felt like forever.
lines.emo: Tender, remembering, a soft smile in the voice.

lines.text: Daddy, build a castle with me?
lines.emo: Hopeful, tugging at his sleeve, rising question.
Short, flat, absent, not looking up, typing.

lines.text: Can we go to the beach?
lines.emo: Quiet, a bit sad, looking at the rain, rising question.
Distracted, talking on the phone at the same time, quick.
Excited, proud, shouting across the beach.
Absent-minded mumble, eyes on the laptop.
Hopeful, a bit awkward, trying to reconnect, rising question.
Cold, bored, dismissive, closing the door.

lines.text: I kept saying later. The sand kept falling.
Then one day, the top was almost empty.
Grandpa, build a castle with me?

lines.emo: Emotional, choked up, smiling through tears, firm and warm.

lines.text: You can't stop the sand. But you can choose what it builds.
lines.emo: Warm, wise, gentle, slow, final words of the story.

lines.text: One grain. One day of your life.
